item.description: I am a human geneticist with a strong interest and experience in genomics and computational analysis of genomic data to diagnose and understand hereditary diseases. My research focuses on identifying and characterizing genetic variants associated with inherited disorders using patient-derived data and disease models, with particular attention to the non-coding genome, where deep intronic and regulatory variants remain difficult to detect and interpret. I work in translational genomics and use perturbation approaches, both in silico and experimental, to connect sequence variation to its functional consequences and to turn that knowledge into improved diagnosis and therapy development.
